title: Karbal Dy Musafir Nu Roo Akhdi Rae Sughra
body:
Karbal day Musafir nu Roo Akhdi raee sughra
<<DIVIDER>>
Koi Akbar nu jaa k akhy Odhi behan dukhiyaari
Takdi paee ay Raah
<<DIVIDER>>
Koi das dy jaa k AKBAR nu k Vichri SUGHRA
Hay Vichri SUGHRA
Raee Behnaa nu tak k daway Dua ay
inj naa howay
Koi Veer toon Judaa
<<DIVIDER>>
Andaa har saah jandaa har Saah Meri Tasbeeh hoya
Hay Tasbeeh Hoya
Inj har saah dy Naal Do Do Waari
Veer AKBAR main
Tera Naam Leya
Meri Akhiyaan Teri Rahwaan
Naal Mantaan deeway
Hay Mantaan deeway
Aihoo reh gaee ay Meri Qismat AKBAR
Rooz rondi aan
Tak ky Taiz Hawaa
Koi apna na jithy howay othy jeewaan kiwaain
Hay jeewaan kiwaain
Menu kaindy ny Loog Yasrab walay
hun Yasrab vich
Tera kon reyaa
Tery hisy Veer Aya way sang BaBay daa
Hay Sang babay daa
Mery hisay ch aiyaan Tangaan Hareeh khaali wehray
Ty Tera Naqash e Paa
